description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, such as calculating string length with multibyte support, finding positions within strings, extracting substrings, transforming case, generating tokens, and compatibility functions for PHP versions. It appears to be a helper module used across the OpenCart project.

methods.name: oc_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_substr
methods.description: Returns a portion of a string supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_token
methods.description: Generates a random token string of specified length.
